DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)

The combination of fever, altered mentation, haloperidol use, and your report of normal CK levels (ruling out severe rhabdomyolysis) strongly points to early or mild NMS, where the primary signs are autonomic instability and mental status changes before massive muscle rigidity sets in. Have you noticed any recent changes in your medication dosage or missed doses of haloperidol that might have triggered this reaction?
